records.name: Jabber Sidekick
records.description:
FL4K is joined by a loyal Jabber companion, armed with a Pistol. While accompanied by the Jabber, FL4K's Movement Speed is increased.

Hold [Pet Skill key] to issue an Attack Command, which will cause the Jabber to throw a Radiation Barrel at enemies.

records.name: Fade Away
records.description: FL4K cloaks, turning invisible. FL4K can fire 3 shots while cloaked, and each shot is automatically a Critical Hit. While cloaked, FL4K has increased Movement Speed and Health Regeneration.

records.name: Self-Repairing System
records.description: FL4K's Maximum Health is increased, and they constantly regenerate health.

records.name: Sic'Em
records.description: Attack Command has lowered Cooldown and increased Damage.

records.name: Furious Attack
records.description:
Hunter Skill. After shooting an enemy, FL4K gains a stack of Furious Attack.

For each stack of Furious Attack, FL4K's Handling and Gun Damage are increased, and their pet gains increased Damage per stack. Stacks decay after a few seconds.

records.name: Guerrillas In The Mist
records.description: Fade Away no longer ends after FL4K attacks, at the cost of Critical Hit Damage and Fade Away duration being reduced.

records.name: Eager To Impress
records.description:
Kill Skill. Whenever FL4K kills an enemy, Action Skill Cooldown Time is reduced.

Whenever FL4K's pet kills an enemy, Action Skill Cooldown Time is reduced even more and Attack Command's duration is refreshed.

records.name: All My BFF's
records.description: Allies share a portion of FL4K's total Health Regeneration. FL4K's pet shares twice the amount of Health Regeneration.

records.name: Overclocked
records.description: FL4K gains increased Fire Rate. FL4K gains even more Fire Rate after reloading.

records.name: Not My Circus
records.description:
After Fade Away ends, FL4K's pet will Taunt, drawing the attention of all enemies in a huge radius.
For a few seconds after Taunting, the pet gains powerful Damage Resistance.

records.name: Lick The Wounds
records.description: When FL4K is in Fight For Your Life, their pet will attempt to revive them. If it does, it gains increased Damage for a short time.

records.name: Turn Tail And Run
records.description:
While moving, FL4K constantly regenerates health and gains Damage Resistance.

While still, FL4K gains Gun Damage and Fire Rate.

records.name: Beefcake Jabber
records.description: FL4K's Jabber evolves into a Beefcake, discarding its pistol and equipping a Shotgun. While accompanied by the Beefcake, FL4K gains increased Movement Speed and Maximum Health. When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the Beefcake will summon a melee weapon to deliver a powerful attack that knocks enemies back.

records.name: Until You Are Dead
records.description: The Health Regeneration and Movement Speed of Fade Away persists for a short time after the skill has ended.

records.name: The Fast And The Furryous
records.description: While above half health, FL4K's Gun Damage and Movement Speed are increased, and their pet gains increased Damage.

records.name: Hidden Machine
records.description: When an enemy has no target or is attacking a different target, FL4K deals increased damage against them.

records.name: Gunslinger Jabber
records.description: FL4K's Jabber upgrades his gear and equips an SMG. While accompanied by the Gunslinger, FL4K gains increased Movement Speed and Critical Hit Damage. When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the Gunslinger equips a Rocket Launcher to attack the target.

records.name: Unblinking Eye
records.description: During Fade Away, successive hits on the same target increase FL4K's Critical Damage per hit. Unblinking Eye resets every 3 hits.

records.name: Rage And Recover
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, FL4K and FL4K's pet regenerate health for a few seconds.

records.name: The Power Inside
records.description: FL4K and FL4K's pet gain increased Damage when FL4K activates an Action Skill. If FL4K is at full health, the increased Damage is doubled.

records.name: Guard Skag
records.description: FL4K is joined by a loyal Skag companion, which will increase FL4K's Damage. Hold [Pet Skill key] to issue an Attack Command, which will cause the Skag to vomit acid onto enemies.

records.name: Gamma Burst
records.description: FL4K creates a Rift at a target location, teleporting their pet through the Rift and dealing Radiation Damage to nearby enemies. Additionally, FL4K's pet becomes irradiated, growing in size and dealing bonus Radiation Damage when it attacks. Using Gamma Burst while FL4K's pet is downed or dead will revive the pet at the targeted location with 30% of its health, but will double Action Skill Cooldown Time.

records.name: Ferocity
records.description: FL4K's Pet deals increased damage.

records.name: Persistence Hunter
records.description: Increases FL4K's Gun Damage and Action Skill Duration.

records.name: Go For The Eyes!
records.description: When FL4K's pet attacks an enemy, the first melee attack is an automatic Critical Hit that deals increased damage.

records.name: Atomic Aroma
records.description: While Gamma Burst is active, FL4K's pet is surrounded by a Radiation Aura, constantly damaging all nearby enemies.

records.name: Who Rescued Who?
records.description: Whenever FL4K's Pet deals damage, FL4K regenerates health for a few seconds. Whenever FL4K deals damage to an enemy, their Pet's health is restored for a portion of the damage dealt.

records.name: He Bites!
records.description: When FL4K's pet takes damage, the pet returns some of that damage to the attacker.

records.name: Frenzy
records.description: Hunter Skill. When FL4K's pet deals damage, FL4K and their pet gain a stack of Frenzy. Each stack of Frenzy increases Damage. The stacks decay after a few seconds.

records.name: Empathic Rage
records.description: For the duration of Gamma Burst, Damage dealt by FL4K is increased.

records.name: Psycho Head On A Stick
records.description: Hunter Kill Skill. Whenever FL4K kills an enemy, their pet gains increased Movement Speed and Damage for a few seconds.

records.name: Hive Mind
records.description: When FL4K takes damage, a portion of all damage they take is inflicted on their pet instead and their pet deals Bonus Damage for a short time.

records.name: Great Horned Skag
records.description:
FL4K's Skag evolves into a larger Great Horned Skag, which will increase FL4K's Damage and Gun Damage.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the Great Horned Skag will charge at enemies and knock them into the air.

records.name: Endurance
records.description: When FL4K or FL4K's pet kills an enemy while Gamma Burst is active, the duration of Gamma Burst is extended and pet damage is increased. These effects can stack up to 5 times.

records.name: Barbaric Yawp
records.description: Increases the power of Pet Bonuses granted to FL4K.

records.name: Mutated Defenses
records.description: When FL4K's pet is at low health, it gains Damage Reduction and regenerates health. This skill has a long cooldown.

records.name: Eridian Skag
records.description:
FL4K's Skag evolves into an Eridian Skag, which will increase FL4K's Damage and Fire Rate.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, their Eridian Skag pulls nearby enemies in by generating a Singularity.

records.name: Burst Aid
records.description: After using Gamma Burst, the Rift remains for the duration of the skill. While standing near the Rift, FL4K and their allies rapidly Regenerate Health.

records.name: Pack Tactics
records.description:
All damage dealt by FL4K and their pet is increased.

Additionally, the Maximum Health of both FL4K and their pet is increased.

records.name: Shared Spirit
records.description: While FL4K is at low health, a portion of all damage they take is converted into healing for their pet instead.

records.name: Dominance
records.description:
Whenever FL4K attacks an enemy with a melee attack or scores a Critical Hit with a weapon while aiming down sights they establish Dominance over that enemy turning it into an ally for a short time. if the enemy is a Beast, the duration is doubled.

While under the effect of Dominance, other enemies are more likely to attack it and it constantly loses health until it dies or the effect ends. Once Dominance ends, a Radiation Nova is created centered around that enemy. Only one enemy can be under the effect of Dominance at a time and an enemy may only be affected once.

records.name: Spiderant Centurion
records.description:
FL4K is joined by a loyal Spiderant companion, which will cause FL4K to constant regenerate health.

Hold [Pet Skill key] to issue an Attack Command, which will cause the Spiderant to charge into enemies.

records.name: Rakk Attack!
records.description: FL4K sends forward 2 Rakk to dive-bomb enemies. This skill has multiple charges. Element: Incendiary.

records.name: Interplanetary Stalker
records.description:
Hunter Kill Skill. Whenever FL4K kills an enemy, they gain a stack of Interplanetary Stalker. For each stack of Interplanetary Stalker, they and their pet gain a bonus to all damage dealt

Additionally, they gain a unique stacking bonus depending on the type of enemy killed. Each unique bonus can stack up to 3 times. Each stack decays after a short time.

records.name: Leave No Trace
records.description: When FL4K scores a Critical Hit, there is a chance for 1 ammo to be added to their magazine.

records.name: Second Intention
records.description: Hunter Kill Skill. Whenever FL4K kills an enemy, they gain increased Reload Speed. This bonus is increased if FL4K scores a Critical Kill.

records.name: Rakk Open A Cold One
records.description: Converts FL4K's Rakk to Cryo Damage.

records.name: Hunter's Eye
records.description: FL4K gains bonuses when fighting different types of enemies.

records.name: Head Count
records.description: Whenever FL4K scores a Critical Hit, there is a chance their Action Skill Cooldown is reduced.

records.name: Ambush Predator
records.description: While there are no enemies nearby, FL4K's Weapon Handling and Critical Hit Damage are increased.

records.name: Falconer's Feast
records.description: When FL4K's Rakk damage an enemy, a portion of FL4K's health is restored.

records.name: Two F4ng
records.description: FL4K has a chance to fire an extra projectile per shot.

records.name: Spiderant Scorcher
records.description:
FL4K's Spiderant evolves into a Scorcher, occasionally dealing Incendiary Damage to all enemies nearby. While accompanied by the Scorcher, FL4K constantly regenerates health and deals increased Elemental Damage.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the Scorcher will charge enemies.

records.name: Flock'N'Load
records.description: FL4K sends forward additional Rakk.

records.name: Big Game
records.description: FL4K's Hunter Skills become much more effective and have a longer duration.

records.name: The Most Dangerous Game
records.description:
Hunter Kill Skill. Whenever FL4K kills a Badass or stronger enemy, they gain increased Critical Hit Damage, Gun Damage, and Handling for a long time and their pet receives increased Damage for a long time.

Additionally, they receive a cash reward from the Intergalactic Bureau of Bounty Hunting.

records.name: Spiderant Countess
records.description:
FL4K's Spiderant evolves into a Countess, which will cause FL4K to constantly regenerate health and gain Damage Resistance.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the Countess will burrow underground and then emerge dealing Corrosive Damage in an area.

records.name: Rakkcelerate
records.description: FL4K's Rakk have increased Cooldown Rate and gain an Additional Charge.

records.name: Galactic Shadow
records.description: FL4K deals increased Critical Hit Damage, and enemies are less likely to attack them.

records.name: Grim Harvest
records.description: FL4K gains increased Gun Damage and Action Skill Damage. FL4K's pet gains increased Damage.

records.name: Megavore
records.description: FL4K gains a chance to score a Critical Hit with weapons against any part of enemies.

records.name: Pet Ion Loader
records.description:
FL4K is joined by a loyal Mini ION Loader Bot companion, armed with a Shock Sniper Rifle and Homing Shock Orbs that can be shot to trigger a Shock Nova. While accompanied by the ION Loader, FL4K gains increased Elemental Damage Resistance.
Hold [Pet Skill key] to issue an Attack Command, which causes the ION Loader to fire a powerful Eye Laser at the enemy.

records.name: Gravity Snare
records.description: FL4K tosses out a Trap that Knocks Up and temporarily Stuns nearby enemies. After being deployed, the Trap periodically continues to Knock Up and Stun enemies for the duration. While standing near the Trap, pressing [Action Skill key] will pick up the Trap, ending the action skill early and refunding a portion of the remaining duration.

records.name: Gotta Go Fast
records.description: FL4K's pet gains increased Movement Speed and Damage.

records.name: Success Imminent
records.description: Whenever FL4K's or their pet's shield breaks or is filled, they and their pet create a Radation Nova. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Agility Training
records.description: FL4K and their pet gain increased Reload Speed.

records.name: Forage
records.description: Whenever an enemy trapped by FL4K is knocked into the air, they drop ammo, health boosters, and shield boosters.

records.name: Better Toys
records.description: FL4K and their pet gain increased Shield Recharge Rate and improved Shield Recharge Delay.

records.name: Combat Veterinarian
records.description: Whenever FL4K shoots the same enemy their pet is attacking, FL4K's Pet gains a portion of the damage dealt back as health.

records.name: Throatripper
records.description: Hunter Skill. FL4K's pet's acttacks have a chance to score a Critical Hit, dealing increased damage.

records.name: Wide Net
records.description: FL4K's Trap gains increased Duration and increased Radius.

records.name: Lethal Force Authorized
records.description:
Whenever Fl4K's Loader Bot pet would go into Fight For Your Life, it turns into an EXP Loader instead and seeks out a nearby enemy before self-destructing, dealing damage to all nearby enemies.
FL4K's pet's respawn time is reduced.

records.name: Take This!
records.description: FL4K's pet gains a copy of FL4K's shield.

records.name: Bul Loader
records.description:
FL4K's ION Loader upgrades into a BUL Loader, discarding it's sniper rifle and equipping a Shotgun. FL4K's BUL Loader also gains increased Damage Resistance and a powerful Roundhouse Melee Attack. While accompanies by the BUL Loader, FL4K's Shield Capacity is increased.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the BUL Loader Briefly turns into a BullDozer to charge at enemies and knocks them up.

records.name: Trap Card
records.description: If FL4K would go into Fight For Your Life while their Trap is readied, they automatically throw a Trap at the enemy that downed them.

records.name: Monkey Do!
records.description:
FL4K's pet gains increased Critical Hit Damage.

Whenever FL4K's Pet scores a Critical Hit, FL4K's next shot deals Bonus Damage based on their weapon's damage.

records.name: Wooly Armor
records.description: While FL4K's shields are full, their pet gains Damage Reduction.

records.name: Not Even A Challenge
records.description: Whenever FL4K's pet kills an enemy, FL4K gains increased Action Skill Duration and Action Skill Cooldown Rate for a short time. This effect stacks.

records.name: War Loader
records.description:
FL4K's ION Loader Upgrades into a WAR Loader, discarding it's sniper rifle and equipping an Incendiary Shotgun and Grenades. While accompanied by the WAR Loader, FL4K gains increased Fire Rate.

When FL4K issues an Attack Command, the WAR loader unleashes a barrage of missles at the target.

records.name: Blind With Anger
records.description: FL4K's Trap no longer Knocks Up or Stuns enemies. Instead, the Trap confuses nearby enemies, causing them to attack their allies for a short time. Once deployed, the Trap continues to periodically confuse enemies for the duration.

records.name: Fuzzy Math
records.description: Whenever FL4K or their pet scores a Critical Hit, a portion of FL4K's and their pet's shields are restored.

records.name: Keep Them Safe
records.description: Whenever FL4K issues an Attack Command, if FL4K's or their pet's shield is less than half full a portion of FL4K's and their pet's shields are restored. This has a short cooldown.

records.name: Capacitance
records.description: Whenever FL4K activiates their Action Skill, they gain greatly increased Shield Capacity for a short time and immediately begin rechargin their shields. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Minigun
records.description: The Minigun is capable of sustained rapid fire. Firing for long periods causes the Minigun to overheat, rendering it inoperable for a few seconds. Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Cloud of Lead
records.description: Occasionally, Moze's and Iron Bear's shots will deal additional Incendiary Damage and won't consume ammo.

records.name: Dakka Bear
records.description: Adds a manned turret to the back of Iron Bear. While manned, Iron Bear and its rider gain increased damage.

records.name: Matched Set
records.description: Moze's currently equipped weapon gains a stacking bonus to Magazine Size and Decreased Heat Per Shot for every piece of equipped gear that has a matching manufacturer.

records.name: Let Off Some Steam
records.description: Minigun deals more damage as heat increases, and can be fired for longer before overheating.

records.name: Stoke the Embers
records.description: Increases Moze and Iron Bear's Incendiary Damage.

records.name: Redistribution
records.description: After Moze scores a Critical Hit, she regenerates ammo and health for a few seconds.The lower her health, the more powerful the regeneration.

records.name: Scrappy
records.description: While moving, Moze's Weapon Damage, Handling, Weapon Swap, and Mode Switch Speed are increased.

records.name: Salamander
records.description: The Salamander is a flamethrower that deals Incendiary Damage to enemies at close range. Though the Salamander has infinite ammo, it drains Fuel with use.

records.name: General Winter
records.description: Minigun fires Cryo rounds which reduce Heat Gain and Fuel Drain.

records.name: Rushin' Offensive
records.description: Moze can sprint and shoot at the same time. While sprinting, Moze's weapons gain Life Steal.

records.name: Scorching RPM's
records.description: Moze gains increased Fire Rate and Critical Hit Damage. Iron Bear gains increased Hard Point damage.

records.name: Fuel Economy
records.description: Reduces Salamander's Fuel Drain. Additionally, Iron Bear's Movement Speed is increased after damaging an enemy with Salamander.

records.name: Exploding. Bullets.
records.description: Minigun fires Explosive Rounds that deal increased Splash Damage, but its Fire Rate is decreased.

records.name: The Iron Bank
records.description: Increases Moze's Magazine Size.

records.name: Specialist Bear
records.description: Equipping two of the same Weapons on Iron Bear increases the damage they deal.

records.name: Chemical Warfare
records.description: Salamander now deals Corrosive Damage. Additionally, Salamander's Melt Damage is increased.

records.name: Some for the Road
records.description: Moze gains infinite ammo for a few seconds after exiting Iron Bear.

records.name: Click, Click...
records.description: Moze gains increased Gun Damage as her magazine empties. The less ammo there is remaining, the greater the increase. If Moze has a COV gun equipped, she gains Gun Damage as her gun's heat increases.

records.name: Molten Roar
records.description: The Salamander burst-fires 3 projectiles with increased Damage, the first of which leaves a large Incendiary area.

records.name: Forge
records.description: Moze constantly regenerates ammo for her currently equipped weapon.

records.name: V-35 Grenade Launcher
records.description: The V-35 is a semi-automatic grenade launcher. Its grenades are not affected by Moze's equipped grenade mod. Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Fire in the Skag Den
records.description: Whenever Moze and Iron Bear deal Splash Damage, they deal bonus Incendiary Damage.

records.name: Deadlines
records.description: Firing Iron Bear Weapons drains less Fuel. Killing an enemy while Iron Bear is active increases Fuel. This skill has diminishing returns.

records.name: Grizzled
records.description: Kill Skill. Killing an enemy reduces Moze's remaining Action Skill Cooldown Time. This skill has diminishing returns.

records.name: Shaped Charge
records.description: Direct hits with the V-35 deal increased damage.

records.name: Means of Destruction
records.description: Whenever Moze deals Splash Damage, there is a chance to add ammo to her currently equipped weapon's magazine, with a smaller chance to return a grenade.

records.name: Torgue Cross-Promotion
records.description: All Splash Damage dealt by Moze has a chance to double in size. Additionally, Moze and Iron Bear deal increased Splash Damage.

records.name: Stainless Steel Bear
records.description: Iron Bear gains additional armor, increased Maximum Fuel, and increased Damage.

records.name: Vanquisher Rocket Pod
records.description: The Vanquisher Rocket Pod is a rocket launcher capable of rapid-firing volleys of unguided explosive rockets. Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Musical Chairs
records.description: Occasionally, the V-35 fires a Singularity Grenade that pulls in nearby enemies before exploding.

records.name: Pull the Holy Pin
records.description: Moze's grenades have a chance to score a Critical Hit, dealing greatly increased damage. Sources of Critical Hit Damage do not affect grenade Critical Hits.

records.name: Auto Bear
records.description: After Moze exits Iron Bear, it will remain deployed in place for a short time. While Auto Bear remains active, it will target and attack nearby enemies until its duration ends, then it will charge at an enemy and self-destruct.

records.name: Active Tracking
records.description: The Vanquisher Rocket Pod now fires homing rockets and has increased Reload Speed. Hold down [Action Skill key] and aim at enemies to designate up to 6 targets. Releasing Fire Button launches a volley of homing rockets at the designated targets.

records.name: Lock and Speedload
records.description: The V-35's Reload Speed is greatly increased and it now fires a 5-round burst.

records.name: Vampyr
records.description: Whenever Moze damages an enemy with a thrown grenade, for every enemy hit, she restores a portion of her missing health. Iron Bear restores armor for every enemy it deals Splash Damage to.

records.name: Why Can't I Carry All These Grenades
records.description: Increases Moze's grenade carrying capacity.

records.name: Target Softening
records.description: The Vanquisher Rocket Pod deals greatly reduced damage per rocket, but fires in a 6-rocket spread. Additionally, enemies hit by Vanquisher Rocket Pod rockets take increased damage from all sources.

records.name: To the Last
records.description: Moze gains the ability to throw grenades while in Fight For Your Life. If she threw a grenade before gaining a Second Wind, a grenade is refunded.

records.name: Explosive Punctuation
records.description: When Moze deals Splash Damage, her Action Skill Cooldown Rate is briefly increased.

records.name: Hammerdown Protocol
records.description: Instead of a volley of conventional rockets, the Vanquisher Rocket Pod launches a single rocket with a nuclear warhead, dealing massive Radiation Damage.

records.name: Short Fuse
records.description: Whenever Moze deals Gun Damage, there is a chance of a secondary explosion centered on the target.

records.name: Railgun
records.description: The Railgun fires electrified high-velocity projectiles that deal Shock Damage.

records.name: Selfless Vengeance
records.description: Whenever Moze reloads, she loses a small portion of her health and grants additional Incendiary Damage to her and her allies' rounds for a few seconds.

records.name: Security Bear
records.description:
Iron Bear gains a bubble shield that reduces damage taken. The shield deactivates if it sustains too much damage, reactivating after a short cooldown.
If Iron Cub is equipped, it gains Damage Reduction instead.

records.name: Armored Infantry
records.description: While Moze's shields are active, she gains Damage Resistance and increased Gun Damage.

records.name: Hell on Rails
records.description: Railgun now fires superheated rounds that deal Incendiary Damge, but have increased Fuel Drain per shot.

records.name: Drowning in Brass
records.description:
Kill Skill. Killing an enemy grants Moze a stack of Drowning in Brass.

For each stack of Drowning in Brass, Moze's Fire Rate is reduced, but Gun Damage is increased for both her and her allies.

records.name: Thin Red Line
records.description: A portion of Moze's health is Reserved and cannot be restored, but her Maximum Shield is increased by the same amount.

records.name: Vladof Ingenuity
records.description: Moze's Maximum Shield and Shield Recharge Rate are increased, and she gains resistance to Shock Damage.

records.name: Bear Fist
records.description: The Bear Fist is a pneumatic-driven fist that deals massive damage to a single target at close range. Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Capacitive Armature
records.description: When Railgun hits an enemy, it chains to nearby enemies, dealing reduced Shock Damage to more targets.

records.name: Full Can of Whoop-Ass
records.description: Entering Iron Bear causes Moze's and her allies' shields to immediately begin recharging at an increased Shield Recharge Rate.

records.name: Experimental Munitions
records.description: Whenever Moze and Iron Bear score a Critical Hit, they deal bonus Incendiary Damage.

records.name: Wild Swing
records.description: Whenever Bear Fist hits an enemy, it deals random Bonus Elemental Damage to that enemy and all enemies nearby.

records.name: Corrosive Sabot Round
records.description:
Railgun now fires a specialty round that deals reduced damage and explodes after a short delay.
Railgun shots have reduced Fuel Drain and the Magazine Size is increased.

records.name: Behind the Iron Curtain
records.description: Moze's Shield Recharge Delay is reduced, and her Shield Recharge Rate is increased.

records.name: Desperate Measures
records.description: Moze's Gun Damage and Iron Bear's Damage is increased depending on how low their health is. The lower their health, the greater the increase.

records.name: Close the Distance
records.description: Instead of punching, Iron Bear now launches its Bear Fist forward and grabs enemies at greatly increased range, dealing Shock Damage and pulling them back to Iron Bear.

records.name: Phalanx Doctrine
records.description:
Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Moze gains a stack of Phalanx Doctrine. For every stack of Phalanx Doctrine, Moze's Maximum Shield and Gun Damage are increased. Each stack lasts 30 seconds.

There is no stack limit.

records.name: Force Feedback
records.description: Whenever Moze scores a Critical Kill, her shields immediately begin recharging and she instantly regains a portion of her shield.

records.name: Shockhammer
records.description: Bear Fist is now capable of sustained rapid fire punching. Additionally, Bear Fist has reduced Fuel Drain and deals Bonus Shock Damage with each hit.

records.name: Tenacious Defense
records.description: Whenever Moze's shield is fully depleted, she instantly restores a portion of her shield, and her Gun Damage is increased for a short time. This skill can only trigger after Moze's shields have fully recharged.

records.name: Iron Cub
records.description:
Moze Summons Iron Cub in place of Iron Bear. Iron Cub equips two of whatever weapon is equipped in the remaining Action Skill slot. While deployed, Iron Cub follows Moze and will target and attack enemies for the duration.
Skills that affect Iron Bear affect Iron Cub. Iron Cub still uses Fuel, but usses less of it and deals less damage (because it's smaller).

records.name: Biofuel
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Bear ignites an enemy, they both regenerate health for a short time.

records.name: Big Surplus
records.description: While Moze's Action Skill is cooling down, she deals bonus Incendiary Damage.

records.name: Really Big Guns
records.description: Iron Bear gains increased Damage.

records.name: Double Time
records.description: While Moze's Action Skill is active, she and Iron Bear gain increased Movement Speed.

records.name: Harmonious Havoc
records.description: Moze gains increased Gun Damage for each weapon, shield, and grenade that matches the element of her gun.

records.name: Explosive Fury
records.description: Moze and Iron Bear gain increased Status Effect Damage and Status Effect Chance.

records.name: Fuel For The Fire
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Cub inflicts a Status Effect on an enemy, Iron Cub's armor is restored.

records.name: Baby Nukes
records.description: Whenever Iron Cub is deployed or destroyed, it triggers a nuclear explosion, dealing massive Radation Damage.

records.name: Fired Up
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Bear applies a Status Effect to an enemy, she gains increased Fire Rate for a short time. This effect stacks.

records.name: Nitrotrinadium Engines
records.description: Iron Bear gains increased Maximum Fuel and Action Skill Cooldown Rate.

records.name: Never Going To Give You Up
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Bear applies a Status Effect to an enemy, Iron Bear gains Fuel. This skill had diminishing returns.

records.name: My Little Friend
records.description: Iron Cub spawns with Incendiary Vladof Assault Riffle in addition to Iron Cub's other weapons.

records.name: Efficiency Engine
records.description: Iron Bear gains increased Damage and Damage Resistance.

records.name: Limit Break
records.description: Moze gains increased Action Skill Cooldown Rate whenever she or Iron Bear inflicts a Status Effect on an enemy. This effect stacks.

records.name: Superior Firepower
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Bear inflicts a Status Effect on an enemy, they gain increased Status Effect Damage.

records.name: Running On Fumes
records.description: Whenever Moze or Iron Bear ignites an enemy, Iron Bear does not consume fuel for a short time.

records.name: Barrier
records.description:
Drop a deployable Barrier that blocks incoming projectiles. Zane and his allies can shoot through the Barrier, dealing increased Gun Damage.

Pressing [Action Skill key] while Barrier is active picks up and holds the Barrier, but the size and bonuses are decreased.

records.name: Adrenaline
records.description: Zane gains increased Action Skill Cooldown Rate. This bonus is based on the amount of shield he has. The more percent full, the greater the bonus.

records.name: Hearty Stock
records.description: Zane gains increased Maximum Shield Capacity.

records.name: Ready for Action
records.description: Zane gains improved Shield Recharge Rate and Shield Recharge Delay.

records.name: Charged Relay
records.description: Whenever Zane or an ally touches the Barrier, they gain increased Movement Speed and Reload Speed for a few seconds.

records.name: Brainfreeze
records.description: Whenever Zane scores a Critical Hit on an enemy, there is a chance they will be Slowed. This effect stacks until the target is Frozen.

records.name: Stiff Upper Lip
records.description: Whenever Zane is damaged, he gains Damage Resistance against that damage type.

records.name: Rise to the Occasion
records.description: Zane gains Health Regeneration. The lower his shield is, the higher the bonus.

records.name: Nanites or Some Shite
records.description:
Zane and his allies gain Health Regeneration, increased Reload Speed, and greatly improved Shield Recharge Delay while near his Barrier.

The lower their health, the more health is regenerated.

records.name: Distributed Denial
records.description: Zane's Barrier gains the effects of his currently equipped Shield Mod. Additionally, shield effects are applied to all allies near the Barrier. Bonuses to Zane are reduced.

records.name: All-Rounder
records.description: Zane's Barrier becomes a dome, covering all sides.

records.name: Retaliation
records.description: Zane and allies near the Barrier gain increased Gun Damage for a few seconds after the Barrier takes damage.

records.name: Really Expensive Jacket
records.description: Elemental Status Effects applied to Zane have reduced duration.

records.name: Best Served Cold
records.description: Kill Skill. Whenever Zane kills an enemy, they create a Cryo Nova, dealing damage to all nearby enemies. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Futility Belt
records.description:
Zane gains resistance to non-elemental damage.

Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, all elemental damage Zane takes is converted to non-elemental damage.

records.name: Deterrence Field
records.description: Enemies that touch the Barrier take Shock Damage and are staggered.

records.name: Refreshment
records.description: Whenever Zane damages a frozen enemy with his weapon, he gains some of that damage back as health.

records.name: Calm, Cool, Collected
records.description:
Whenever Zane Freezes an enemy, his shield instantly begins recharging.

If Zane's shields are already full, he regenerates health for a few seconds.

If Zane's health is already full, his Action Skill Cooldowns and Durations are immediately reset.

records.name: Nerves of Steel
records.description: Zane gains increasing Accuracy and Handling. The longer his shield is full, the greater the bonuses.

records.name: Confident Competence
records.description: While Zane's shields are active, he gains increased Gun Damage and Accuracy. These bonuses are based on the amount of shields he has. The more percent full, the greater the bonuses.

records.name: SNTNL
records.description: Send into battle an automated SNTNL drone that continually flies through the environment and attacks enemies with its Machine Guns. Pressing [Action Skill key] while SNTNL is active causes it to attack the enemy under Zane's crosshairs, if any. Machine Gun Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Violent Speed
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane gains increased Movement Speed for a few seconds. This effect stacks twice.

records.name: Cold Bore
records.description: Zane gains increased Weapon Swap Speed. The next shot fired after swapping weapons deals Bonus Cryo Damage.

records.name: Violent Momentum
records.description: Zane's Gun Damage is increased while moving. The quicker he moves, the greater the bonus.

records.name: Winter's Drone
records.description: Converts SNTNL's primary weapons to Cryo Damage.

records.name: Cool Hand
records.description:
Zane gains increased Reload Speed.
Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane's Reload Speed is increased for a few seconds. This effect stacks twice.

records.name: Drone Delivery
records.description: SNTRY will occasionally drop a free grenade based on your current grenade mod while attacking enemies.

records.name: Salvation
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane's weapons gain Life Steal for a few seconds.

records.name: Bad Dose
records.description:
SNTNL occasionally shoots out a beam of Radiation that weakens enemies and buffs Zane.

For every weakened enemy, Zane's Movement Speed and Fire Rate are increased.

Weakened enemies have decreased Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

records.name: Seein' Red
records.description: Activating an Action Skill automatically activates all of Zane's Kill Skills.

records.name: Static Field
records.description: SNTNL emits a static field that sends a Shock Beam to nearby enemies, draining their shields and replenishing Zane's.

records.name: Boomsday
records.description: SNTNL adds a rocket pod to its primary weapons, allowing it to shoot rockets as well as machine guns. Element: Non-Elemental.

records.name: Violent Violence
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane gains increased Fire Rate for a few seconds. This effect stacks twice.

records.name: Playing Dirty
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane's next five shots all have a chance to fire an additional projectile.

records.name: Almighty Ordnance
records.description: Hold down [Action Skill key] while SNTNL is deployed to paint a target area. SNTNL fires a missile barrage at that area, and if an enemy is killed, SNTNL's duration is reset. This can only be used once per Action Skill use.

records.name: Good Misfortune
records.description: Kill Skill. Killing an enemy increases Zane's Action Skill Duration. This skill has diminishing returns.

records.name: Death Follows Close
records.description: All of Zane's Kill Skills gain increased effect and duration.

records.name: Digi-Clone
records.description: Spawn a Digi-Clone of Zane. The Digi-Clone stays in place, but distracts and fires at enemies. Pressing [Action Skill key] while the Digi-Clone is active causes Zane and the Digi-Clone to swap places.

records.name: Synchronicity
records.description: Zane gains increased Gun Damage for each active Action Skill.

records.name: Praemunitus
records.description: Zane and his Digi-Clone gain increased Magazine Size.

records.name: Borrowed Time
records.description: Zane gains increased Action Skill Duration for each active Action Skill.

records.name: Binary System
records.description: Whenever Zane swaps places with his Digi-Clone, a Cryo Nova is triggered around Zane and his Digi-Clone.

records.name: Donnybrook
records.description: Kill Skill. Whenever Zane kills an enemy, he and his Digi-Clone receive increased Gun Damage and gain Health Regeneration for a few seconds. This effect stacks twice.

records.name: Fractal Frags
records.description:
The Digi-Clone throws a copy of Zane's current grenade mod when it is first activated. If the Digi-Clone is killed, it drops a free grenade.
Kill Skill. Killing an enemy while the Digi-Clone is active gives the Digi-Clone a chance to throw a grenade.

records.name: Duct Tape Mod
records.description: The first shot fired from Zane's gun has a chance to also fire a grenade. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Schadenfreude
records.description: Whenever the Digi-Clone takes damage, Zane's shield is restored by a portion of that damage.

records.name: Quick Breather
records.description: Whenever Zane swaps places with his Digi-Clone, his shield immediately begins recharging and restores health to his clone.

records.name: Which One's Real?
records.description: Enemies are more likely to target the Digi-Clone for a few seconds after it's summoned and after swapping places.

records.name: Dopplebanger
records.description: Hold down [Action Skill key] to end the action skill early. When Zane's Action Skill is ended, the Digi-Clone explodes, dealing Splash Damage to all nearby enemies. The more Action Skill time remaining, the greater the damage.

records.name: Pocket Full of Grenades
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Zane gains Grenade Regeneration for a few seconds.

records.name: Old-U
records.description: Press [Action Skill key] during Fight For Your Life if Digi-Clone is active to destroy the Digi-Clone and immediately gain a Second Wind with full health.

records.name: Supersonic Man
records.description: Whenever one or more of Zane's Action Skills are active, he gains increased Movement Speed for each active Action Skill.

records.name: Digital Distribution
records.description: If Zane takes health damage while the Digi-Clone is active, a portion of that damage is shared on his Digi-Clone instead.

records.name: Like a Ghost
records.description: Zane and his Digi-Clone gain a chance to ignore bullets. This chance is increased for a few seconds after activating an Action Skill. This effect stacks.

records.name: Boom. Enhance.
records.description: Whenever Zane summons his Digi-Clone, it consumes up to 3 grenades. For every grenade consumed, the Digi-Clone gains increased Gun Damage, Maximum Health, Fire Rate, Reload Speed, and Digi-Clone Duration.

records.name: Trick of the Light
records.description: Zane deals Bonus Cryo Damage to enemies that aren't targeting him.

records.name: Double Barrel
records.description: The Digi-Clone is equipped with a copy of Zane's Current Weapon when activated. Swapping places with the Digi-Clone causes Zane and his Digi-Clone to gain increased Gun Damage.

records.name: MNTIS Shoulder Cannon
records.description: Zane equips a Shoulder Mount ed Cannon. Pressing [Action Skill key] causes Zane to fire his cannon at his crosshairs and consume one charge.

records.name: Man Of Focus
records.description: Activating an Action Skill grants Zane increased Accuracy and Handling for a short time. This effect stacks.

records.name: Renegade
records.description: After scoring a Critical Hit, Zane Regenerates Health for a short time.

records.name: Déjà Vu
records.description: Whenever Zane kills an enemy with a Critical Hit, there is a chance for 1 ammo to be added to his magazine.

records.name: Colder Shoulder
records.description: Converts Zane's MNTIS Shoulder Cannon damage to Cryo Damage but deals reduced damage. Additionally, Zane gains Increased Cryo Freeze Rate.

records.name: Headman's Hand
records.description: Kill Skill. Zane gains increased Critical Hit Damage. This effect stacks twice.

records.name: Tunnel Vision
records.description: While moving, Zane gains increased Accuracy and Handling. The quicker Zane moves, the greater the bonus.

records.name: Commitment
records.description: Kill Skill. Zane gains increased Gun Damage and Action Skill Cooldown Rate.

records.name: Wetwork
records.description: Whenever Zane kills an enemy with his Shoulder Cannon, that enemy explodes into an Elemental Puddle.

records.name: Fugitive
records.description: Zane can sprint and shoot at the same time.

records.name: Brain Drain
records.description: Whenever Zane kills an enemy with a Critical Hit from his Shoulder Cannon, two charges are instantly returned.

records.name: No Way Out
records.description: Whenever Zane damages an enemy with his Shoulder Cannon, that enemy is pulled to him and takes Increased Damage for a short time. Additionally, Zane's MNTIS Shoulder Cannon cooldown time is increased.

records.name: Domino Effect
records.description: Whenever Zane scores a Critical Hit, he gains increased Fire Rate and Reload Speed for a short time. If he scores a Critical Hit with his Action Skill, he doubles this effect.

records.name: The Art Of War
records.description: After activating an Action Skill or Action Skill Ability, Zane's next short fired from his weapon deals Increased Damage. This effect stacks.

records.name: Sheer Will
records.description: Zane gains increased Action Skill Cooldown Rate. Scoring a Critical Hit increases this effect. This effect stacks.

records.name: Eraser
records.description: Zane's Critical Hits pierce through enemies for all weapons, dealing Increased Damage for every enemy pierced.

records.name: Proliferation
records.description: Zane's MNTIS Shoulder Cannon gains Additional Charges and deals Increased Damage based on the number of charges remaining.

records.name: Our Man Flint
records.description: While aiming down sights, Zane's weapons deal Bonus Damage and automatically apply their Status Effect when he scores a Critical Hit.

records.name: Phaseslam
records.description: Amara leaps into the air and Slams the ground, dealing damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them up. Element: Shock.

records.name: Root to Rise
records.description: Amara gains increased Maximum Health.

records.name: Personal Space
records.description: Amara's weapon shots deal Bonus Damage based on the distance to her target. The closer the target, the greater the bonus.

records.name: Clarity
records.description: Amara constantly regenerates health. The lower her health, the more powerful the regeneration. After using an Action Skill, this bonus is doubled for a few seconds.

records.name: Arms Deal
records.description: Amara deals increased Splash Damage and takes reduced Splash Damage.

records.name: Samsara
records.description: Whenever Amara deals damage to an enemy with her Action Skill, she adds a stack of Samsara. For every stack of Samsara, Amara gains increased Gun Damage and Health Regeneration for a few seconds. Stacks decay after a few seconds.

records.name: Helping Hand(s)
records.description: For a few seconds after using her Action Skill, Amara's arms remain active and grant her Damage Resistance.

records.name: Blight Tiger
records.description: Converts Amara's Action Skill to Corrosive Damage.

records.name: Fracture
records.description: Amara summons a line of fists that erupt from the ground, dealing damage to enemies in front of Amara. Element: Shock.

records.name: Mindfulness
records.description: Whenever Amara takes damage, she gains a stack of Mindfulness. For every stack of Mindfulness, Amara gains improved Shield Regeneration Delay and Movement Speed. Stacks decay after a few seconds.

records.name: Find Your Center
records.description: Amara gains increased Melee Damage. Additionally, for a few seconds after using her Action Skill, Amara gains increased Melee Range.

records.name: Vigor
records.description: Kill Skill. Killing an enemy with Amara's Action Skill grants all allies increased Movement Speed for a few seconds.

records.name: Revelation
records.description: Amara's Action Skill now creates a Nova when it damages enemies, dealing damage to all nearby enemies.

records.name: Downfall
records.description: Amara leaps into the air and shoots an Elemental Beam below her, followed by a Slam. Element: Shock.

records.name: One With Nature
records.description: Amara gains increased Maximum Health and Elemental Damage Resistance to her Action Skill Element.

records.name: Do Unto Others
records.description: Whenever an enemy damages Amara, she automatically throws an energy orb back at them, dealing Action Skill Elemental Damage. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Jab Cross
records.description: Whenever Amara deals melee damage to an enemy, she gains increased Action Skill Damage and increased Gun Damage for a few seconds.

records.name: Guardian Angel
records.description: When Amara enters Fight For Your Life, she immediately gains a Second Wind, restores her health, and creates an Action Skill Elemental Nova that may knock back nearby enemies. This skill has a long cooldown.

records.name: Glamour
records.description: Enemies damaged by Amara's Action Skill become confused and temporarily attack their allies. However, Action Skill Cooldown is increased. If Amara targets an enemy with Phasegrasp, enemies near the Grasped target are confused as well.

records.name: Blitz
records.description: Melee Override. Press [Melee key] while aiming at an enemy to make Amara dash a short distance forward and perform a special melee strike, dealing Elemental Melee Damage. If a Blitz melee attack kills an enemy, Blitz's cooldown is immediately reset.

records.name: Phasecast
records.description: Amara sends forward an Astral Projection of herself, dealing damage to everything in its path. Element: Shock.

records.name: Do Harm
records.description: Killing an enemy grants Amara a stack of Rush. Activating her Action Skill consumes all Rush stacks. For every stack of Rush consumed, Amara's Action Skill Damage is temporarily increased.

records.name: Fast Hand(s)
records.description: Amara's Reload Speed, Weapon Swap Speed, and Mode Switch Speed are improved.

records.name: Violent Tapestry
records.description: Applying a Status Effect grants Amara a stack of Rush. Activating her Action Skill consumes all Rush stacks. For every stack of Rush consumed, Amara's Status Effect Chance is temporarily increased.

records.name: Alacrity
records.description: Amara gains increased Reload Speed for every stack of Rush. After consuming Rush stacks, this bonus is increased for a few seconds.

records.name: Transcend
records.description: Amara gains increased Accuracy and Critical Hit Damage for a few seconds after activating her Action Skill.

records.name: Restless
records.description: Amara gains increased Action Skill Cooldown Rate.

records.name: Soul Sap
records.description: A portion of all damage dealt by Amara's Action Skill is returned to her or a nearby ally as health.

records.name: Deliverance
records.description: Amara sends forward an Astral Projection of herself, dealing damage to everything in its path. Whenever Amara's Astral Projection damages an enemy or object, it releases homing Elemental Projectiles that trigger her Action Skill Elemental Effect on enemies. Element: Shock.

records.name: Ascendant
records.description: All Action Skill Augments gain increased effects.

records.name: Stillness of Mind
records.description: Enemies damaged by Amara's Action Skill become phaselocked until they are damaged or the duration ends. However, Action Skill Cooldown is increased. If Amara targets an enemy with Phasegrasp, enemies near the Grasped target are also phaselocked.

records.name: Reverberation
records.description: Amara sends forward an Astral Projection of herself, dealing damage to everything in its path. Astral Projection deals increased damage for every enemy it hits. Element: Shock.

records.name: From Rest
records.description: Amara gains improved Fire Rate and Charge Time.

records.name: Laid Bare
records.description: Enemies take increased damage from all sources for a few seconds after being damaged by Amara's Action Skill.

records.name: Wrath
records.description: Amara gains increased Gun Damage. This effect is increased after she activates her Action Skill for a few seconds.

records.name: Remnant
records.description: When Amara kills an enemy with a Gun or Action Skill, she creates a homing projectile that seeks out a new enemy dealing her Action Skill Elemental Damage. Any Overkill Damage is added to the projectile's damage.

records.name: Awakening
records.description: Amara's Rush stacks gain increased effectiveness.

records.name: Tandava
records.description: Amara sends forward an Astral Projection of herself. When it hits a target, it explodes, damaging all nearby enemies. Element: Shock.

records.name: Avatar
records.description:
Amara's Action Skill can be activated while it's cooling down. This skill may only be used once per completed cooldown.

Additionally, increases Amara's Maximum Rush Stacks.

Additionally, if Amara's Action Skill kills an enemy, it refunds half of her Rush stacks.

records.name: Phasegrasp
records.description: Amara summons a giant fist that bursts from the ground and locks the targeted enemy in place for a few seconds. Some enemies are immune to being Grasped and instantly take damage instead. Element: Shock.

records.name: Anima
records.description: Amara's Status Effects deal increased damage over time and have increased duration. Her Action Skill Status Effect deals further increased damage.

records.name: Steady Hands
records.description: Amara gains increased Weapon Handling and Accuracy.

records.name: Infusion
records.description: Convert a portion of damage dealt by Amara's weapons into her Action Skill Element.

records.name: Tempest
records.description: Amara deals increased Elemental Damage. Shock Damage is further increased.

records.name: Illuminated Fist
records.description: Amara gains increased Melee Damage and her Melee Damage is converted to Action Skill Element.

records.name: Wildfire
records.description: Whenever Amara applies a Status Effect to an enemy, it has a chance to spread to a nearby enemy.

records.name: Soulfire
records.description: Converts Amara's Action Skill to Incendiary Damage.

records.name: The Eternal Fist
records.description: Amara summons a giant fist that bursts from the ground and locks the targeted enemy in place for a few seconds. Whenever the Grasped enemy is killed, a new fist seeks out and Grasps a new target. Some enemies are immune to being Grasped and instantly take damage instead. Element: Shock.

records.name: Dread
records.description: Amara's Gun Damage is increased for a few seconds after an enemy is Grasped. Whenever any player kills a Grasped enemy, their current weapon is instantly reloaded.

records.name: Allure
records.description: Amara's Action Skill creates a singularity that pulls in enemies.

records.name: Indiscriminate
records.description: Amara's bullets that damage enemies have a chance to ricochet and deal decreased damage to other nearby enemies. Ricochet Chance and Damage are increased if target is affected by Phasegrasp or Stillness of Mind.

records.name: Deep Well
records.description: Amara gains increased Magazine Size with elemental weapons.

records.name: Catharsis
records.description: Whenever Amara triggers an elemental effect on an enemy, when that enemy dies that enemy explodes, dealing her attuned element damage along with any other element that is currently inflicted upon that enemy. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Ties That Bind
records.description: Amara summons a giant fist that bursts from the ground and locks the targeted enemy in place for a few seconds. Enemies near the Grasped target are linked, and any damage dealt to a linked target is shared between all other linked targets. Some enemies are immune to being Grasped and instantly take damage instead. Element: Shock.

records.name: Fist Over Matter
records.description: Amara summons a giant fist that bursts from the ground and locks the targeted enemy in place for a few seconds. After Grasping the targeted enemy, large fists appear and constantly smash the area, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Some enemies are immune to being Grasped and instantly take damage instead. Element: Shock.

records.name: Sustainment
records.description: Amara gains Life Steal whenever she deals Elemental Damage with her weapon.

records.name: Conflux
records.description: Whenever Amara applies a Status Effect to an enemy, she gains a chance to randomly Electrocute, Ignite, or Melt that enemy.

records.name: Forceful Expression
records.description: Amara's guns deal Bonus Elemental Damage based on her Action Skill Element.

records.name: Phaseflare
records.description:
Amara summons an Orb of Elemental Energy that deals constant elemental damage to nearby enemies.

Pressing [Melee key] near the Orb causes it to fly towards toward an enemy and damage them. Addiontally, every time Amara uses a melee attack on the Orb, it gains Increased Damage based on the damage she dealt to it.

Pressing [Action Skill key] causes the Orb to return to Amara.

records.name: Trust In Yourself
records.description: Whenever an enemy breaks Amara's shield, she gains increased Reload Speed, Charge Speed, and Weapon Swap Speed for a short time. This effect is doubled if Amara's shield is broken by a melee attack.

records.name: No Mistakes In Nature
records.description: Whenever Amara inflicts a Status Effect on an enemy, she gains increased Melee Damage for a short time.

records.name: Heavy Rain
records.description: Amara's weapons gain increased Projectile Speed and Splash Damage.

records.name: Glow Up
records.description: Instead of dealing Splash Damage to enemies, Amara's Orb grants nearby allies Health Regeneration. Amara my also press [Melee key] while near the orb to send it to a downed ally, granting them a Second Wind.

records.name: Go With The Flow
records.description: Whenever Amara Freezes an enemy, she gains increased Movement Speed and Weapon Damage for a short time.

records.name: Unweave The Rainbow
records.description: Amara deals Bonus Damage of her attuned element whenever she deals Melee Damage or Splash Damage to frozen enemies.

records.name: Ebb And Flow
records.description: Whenever Amara kills an enemy with a melee attack, she gains a portion of the damage dealt back as health.

records.name: Cold Hearted
records.description: Converts Amara's Action Skill to Cryo Damage.

records.name: Shooting Star
records.description: Amara summons an Orb of Elemental Energy that deals constant elemental damage to nearby enemies. Pressing [Melee key] near the Orb causes it to fly forwards toward an enemy and damage them which also increases the amount of Overal Damage the Orb deals to enemies. Additionally, the Elemental Orb continually fires Elemental Projectiles at the last enemy Amara damaged. Pressing [Action Skill key] causes the ORb to return to Amara.

records.name: Combo Breaker
records.description: Killing an enemy with Melee Damage has a chance to reset Amara's Action Skill Cooldown.

records.name: Expedite
records.description: Whenever Amara kills an enemy with her Action Skill, she gains increased Action Skill Cooldown Rate until she activates her Action Skill again.

records.name: Joyful Freedom
records.description: After activating her Action Skill, Amara gains increased Melee Damage for a short time.

records.name: Burn Both Ends
records.description:
After activating her Action Skill, Amara gains Increased Threat for a short time, drawing the attention of all enemies in a huge radius.

Whenever Amara is dealt damage by an enemy, she gains Increased Damage for a short time. This effect stacks.

records.name: Light Fantastic
records.description: Amara summons an Orb of Elemental Energy that deals constant elemental damage to nearby enemies. Whenever Amara damages an enemy, the Elemental Orb automatically travels to that enemy, the Elemental Orb gains Increased Damage. Pressing [Action Skill key] causes the Orb to return to Amara.

records.name: Body And Mind
records.description: Kill Skill. Amara's melee attacks deal Bonus Splash Damage for a short time.

records.name: Free The Soul
records.description: Kill Skill. Whenever Amara kills a frozen enemy, splinters fly out from that enemy and home to nearby enemies, dealing Cryo Damage. This skill has a short cooldown.

records.name: Atman
records.description: Amara gains increased Skill Damage.

records.name: Clear The Mind
records.description: Kill Skill. After killing an enemy, Amara ignores enemie's Elemental Damage Resistance for a short time. This does not affect Elemental Immunity.
